name: Meadbee
ability: Honey Gather / Sweet Veil / Friend Guard (hidden)
look: a plump golden-amber bumblebee with honeycomb wings hugging a tiny clay amphora of nectar
entry: Ancient warriors celebrated victories alongside swarms of Meadbee, whose fermented honey was said to grant courage and song.
how: Wild: common, by day, in the Liquor Meadows (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto 0.8.0).
It learns Nectar Toast at level 21.
